Single-phase transformers and three-phase Y–delta

Buxin She
Mike Wiegers Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Lecture outline
Example 1: single-phase circuit with transformers
1 Two transformer ratios, three voltage zones, and one complete PU solution.
Example 2: three-phase Y– Δ normalization
2 Physical Δ load → equivalent Y → PU model → branch quantities.
Each part follows the circuit and questions with two workflow pages, then the
complete solution.
ECE 685 | Per Unit III 2/48

Example 1: questions
Goal: Solve the single-phase circuit and assess its load voltage.
1 Normalization. Find compatible 𝑉base, 𝑍base, 𝐼base in all zones. Convert the
source and all impedances to pu.
2 Current. Draw the common-base circuit and calculate 𝑍total and 𝐼p.u. in
rectangular and polar forms.
3 Voltages and amperes. Find 𝑉𝐵2, 𝑉𝐵3, 𝑉𝐵4 in pu and kV, then 𝐼1, 𝐼2, 𝐼3 in
